AsyaRae is a Houston-born social media creator who first gained attention through fashion and lifestyle content on social media. She began regularly posting on Instagram around 2020.

She later expanded into livestreaming, building an audience on Kick through IRL and Just Chatting content. Her streams often focus on everyday life, trips, and hanging out with friends.

In September 2026, she streamed an Orlando girls trip, including one marathon session that lasted more than 14 hours. She has also done “day in the life” and family-focused IRL streams.

Her Kick channel has around 55K followers, showing how her content has grown from social-media posts into livestreaming.

Basically, AsyaRae turned everyday life, fashion, and IRL adventures into her own streaming content. 😭🔥
